layout_pattern: 24 pages: 1 title page, 3 TOC pages (unusual — a multi-page TOC, likely one per major section rather than a single agenda page), 20 content pages. This is the only sample so far with a detected TOC at all.

color_role_mapping.FFC000: primary accent — gold/amber, overwhelmingly dominant (2672 occurrences, ~4x the next color). Distinct from every other sample in this corpus, which favor C00000 (dark red).
color_role_mapping.FCC800: secondary gold variant, likely gradient/hover shading of the primary accent
color_role_mapping.FFA700: orange accent, adjacent to the gold family

typography_hierarchy.usage: page headline (1373 occurrences — very high for a title size, suggesting large headline text blocks, not just one-line titles)
dominant body size (3227 — most frequent overall)

data_viz_preference.tables: 17 of 24 pages (71%) — the highest table-density sample in the corpus so far, though note the pdfplumber has_table detector can false-positive on aligned text blocks (see extract_pdf.py caveat) — this number is a weaker signal than the pptx-derived table counts.
data_viz_preference.note: no native charts detected; heavy picture use (20/24) alongside heavy 'table' detection suggests dense data-grid layouts, consistent with a senior-leadership briefing that needs to pack comparative figures per page.

text_density_rule: 95-1462 characters per page (the 3 TOC pages are the short outliers at 95 chars each). Content pages run consistently dense: 615-1462 characters, denser than either pptx deck in this corpus.
logic_flow: Cannot be reconstructed from title text — the PDF extraction script doesn't capture a title-placeholder equivalent (no semantic title tagging in PDF structure), only font-size-based classification. Layout sequence (title -> TOC(x3) -> content) suggests a multi-section report structure, but the narrative arc within/across sections isn't recoverable from this extraction alone.
image_treatment: 477 embedded raster objects across 24 pages (~20/page) — but per the extraction script's caveat, pdfplumber counts every icon/logo/texture fragment individually, so this is not 20 real 'pictures' per page. Zone distribution is broad with a notable full-bleed cluster (20 occurrences) alongside heavy bottom-right/bottom-center weighting — reads as pages built on a full-page background graphic with smaller data-grid icons layered on top. 203 of 477 (43%) have adjacent text within the caption margin, but spot-checking the actual text ('-29% -30%', 'Enterprise business') shows these are data labels/callouts within infographics, not photo captions.
citation_style: 4 explicit citations found, all in the 'Source: X' format, all external market-research/financial sources: 'Source: Huawei financial report', 'Source: Roland Berger' (appears twice), 'Source: 2024 Omdia'. This is the strongest citation discipline in the corpus — every external competitive/market figure appears to carry a named source, consistent with a senior-leadership deck that needs its numbers to be defensible.
branding_footer: No footer, page-number, or confidentiality marker found anywhere in this sample — notable contrast with 技术风格.pdf (same PowerPoint origin per file metadata), which carries 'Huawei Confidential' on every single page.
data_quality_caveats: This is the only PDF sample profiled without a comparable title_text signal (a gap versus the pptx extraction script — worth closing before drawing firm conclusions about logic_flow for PDF sources). The gold/amber color scheme here is a striking outlier versus every other sample in the corpus — confirm this isn't a mis-extraction (e.g., a highlight/annotation layer) before treating it as a real 'senior-audience' convention; if confirmed, it may indicate the deck audience (高层 = senior leadership) drives a deliberately different palette from the C00000-based decks aimed at other audiences.
